firm_data.firm_description: Abrams Garfinkel Margolis Bergson, LLP is a full-service law firm dedicated to smart, practical and cost effective counsel. Our responsive and highly skilled approach is all about delivering positive outcomes to our clients.
notable_facts: The firm represents a diverse range of clients, from entrepreneurs to established institutions.
AGMB has offices in New York and Los Angeles.

additional_contacts.name: Larry Haber
additional_contacts.title: Managing Partner Of Commercial Real Estate

email.subject: AI for AGMB, built for firms managing diverse clients
email.body:
Hi Neil,

Your firm's approach to serving everyone from entrepreneurs to established institutions across banking, real estate, and corporate work demands both precision and speed. That's exactly the problem we solve.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in LA to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office on Thursday, April 10 to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
